sku_format_match: partial - Shopify variant.sku is empty/null for all products. The EDI model code with 'xxK' placeholder (e.g. EDI-UFO-320W-XXK, EDI-LHB4FT-400W-xxK, EDI-VP-4FT60W-xxK) appears in body_html, and the generation (G1..G5) appears in the title, matching the Lumera pattern '<EDI code> G<n>'. Several products share one EDI code across generations. Lumera 'SU-*' and 'US002' SKUs do not appear on this site (web search did not identify their source).

recommended_strategy: Pull the single products.json page. For each product extract the EDI code from body_html (regex '\b(?:EDI|SU|SMA)-[A-Za-z0-9/\-]+') and the generation from title (regex '\bG\d\b'). Match Lumera SKU by (EDI code normalized: uppercase, 'XXK'/'CCT'/'NNK' color suffix treated as wildcard) + generation; fall back to code-only match flagged as approximate. Images are 3000px Shopify CDN JPGs. Expect only a minority of the 142 Lumera SKUs (EDI linear/UFO/VP/panel/troffer/strip lines) to match; SU-*, US002, EDI-AL (area light) and T8 tubes lack a source (T8 shown as SMA-T84F24-AB-xxK G1, not EDI-T84F18).
blockers: Small official catalog (51 products), no SKU field; SU-* product line source not identified.
